name: Jimwyl Steve D. Perez
summary: I graduated in Mechanical Engineering from the University of San Carlos and passed the licensure examination in February 2025. My hands-on experience is in flour mill maintenance engineering, and my technical training covers mechanical drafting, mechatronics servicing, welding, and lubrication.

timeline.detail: Interned with the Flour Mill Maintenance Engineering Department, working alongside the maintenance team on the mill's mechanical equipment.
